result.title: DecisionReplay: A Corpus and Offline Simulator for Ensembling Decision Models
result.summary: Comparing ensembles, routers and cascades requires the output of every model on every item, and its cost. Stored collections built for routing keep no per-option probabilities. We provide a dataset on which ensemble methods, routers and cascades are simulated quickly, without new model calls. DecisionReplay holds the probability vectors of 17 commercial decision models, endpoints that return a probability for every answer option, on 35 benchmarks, with the token counts, billed cost and measured latency of every call, all released. A deterministic simulator replays any policy that selects, combines or cascades them. One well-chosen model per benchmark is hard to beat: pooling all models loses 2.7 accuracy points to it, and stacking gains 1.0 points at 3.4 times its cost. The models are wrong together: two that are both wrong choose the same wrong option in 72% of cases. The best router matches that model at 64% of its cost, and certified early exit cuts the cost of a stacked ensemble by 43% without changing an answer. DecisionReplay makes it cheap and fast to test whether a new method changes these results.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 DecisionReplay 语料与确定性离线模拟器，记录 17 个商业决策模型在 35 个基准上的逐选项概率、token 数、成本与延迟，以低成本回放路由、集成与级联策略，并报告单模型难被超越、模型错误高度相关、认证式早退降本等结论。
AI.relevance_reason: 其带成本与延迟的离线策略回放可供核查 LVR 中 STOP 阈值与多 latent 假设集成的收益成本评估，错误共现统计也可能提示假设多样性的度量方式；但对象为非视觉决策模型，迁移需较多核查。
